Эпиктет, Енхиридіонъ, перевод Григория Полетики, 1767, печатные главы 6–10, стр. 59–65; самостоятельная транскрипция по цифровому экземпляру РНБ.
Only standard chapters 2–5 of the Enchiridion, corresponding to printed chapters 6–10 on pages 59–65 of Poletyka’s 1767 edition. Historical spelling is retained; printed section headings, line wraps, stress marks and the long footnote to chapter 5 are omitted. Other chapters are not represented by this witness. Scan images remain in local artifact custody; this is an independent manual transcription.
restrictions: Identify the 1767 translator and the source; preserve the limited coverage.
rationale: The translator died in 1784; the 1767 translation is public domain in Russia and in the United States. The independent textual transcription does not reproduce the modern library images.
